title: A WoW Player Hit Level 90 Without Leaving the Starting Island
hook: In June 2014 a pandaren named Doubleagent hit WoW's level cap after more than 170 days of play time, without ever leaving the Wandering Isle or picking a faction. Could you level a character by picking flowers?
script: Did you know a World of Warcraft player reached level ninety without ever leaving the starting island? When Mists of Pandaria launched in twenty twelve, new pandaren characters began on the Wandering Isle. At the end of that zone the game makes you pick a side, Alliance or Horde, before you can leave. A player named Doubleagent refused. He stayed neutral and never stepped off the island. Without a faction he could not run dungeons, fight in battlegrounds, or even use a mailbox. So he picked flowers and mined ore. Each herb or rock gave him a tiny amount of experience, and the level cap was ninety. Then in June of twenty fourteen he finally reached the cap, after more than 170 days of play time. That is more than 4,000 hours of clicking plants on one small island. He did not stop there. He kept going through every expansion since, hitting each new level cap the same way. When Shadowlands cut the cap to sixty in twenty twenty, he reached it again within weeks of launch, still without choosing a side. He told PC Gamer he does it for himself. Would you have the patience to level a character this way? Follow for more gaming history.
